title: Three new species of Betamorpha Hessler & Thistle, 1975 (Isopoda: Asellota: Munnopsidae) from the Japan and Kuril-Kamchatka Trenches, with an updated key to the species of the genus
content:
Abstract
Three new species of the genus Betamorpha Hessler & Thistle, 1975, collected from depths of 2,886–7,654 m in the Japan and Kuril-Kamchatka Trenches in the northwestern Pacific are described. These new species, Betamorpha crista sp. nov., Betamorpha fossa sp. nov., and Betamorpha ellipsoidea sp. nov., are distinguished from each other and their congeners based on morphological characters of the cephalothorax, pereonites I–V, and coxal plates. The specimens were collected at different depths and not sympatrically: 2,886–3,176 m for B. crista sp. nov., 5,702–5,738 m for B. fossa sp. nov., and 6,169–7,654 m for B. ellipsoidea sp. nov. We determined partial nucleotide sequences of the mitochondrial cytochrome c oxidase subunit I (COI) gene, constructed a COI-based phylogenetic tree of Betamorpha, and calculated intra- and interspecific genetic distances. A key to the species of Betamorpha is provided.
